description: Test script for setting and validating Ethernet WAN port using HAL functions in a broadband device, including module loading, configuration, port setting, verification, and cleanup.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test commands.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the test step and returns the result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result status of the executed test step.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed output from the test step execution.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the pass/fail status for the test step.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the specified module after test completion.
